card.title: How To Fix iPhone 8 That Restarts When You Make A Phone Call

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 8 That Restarts When You Make A Phone Call

claims.statement: iPhone 8 restarting as a call starts is usually a corroded ALS/proximity sensor on the front camera flex; confirm by unplugging it, then replace or clean it.

procedure: Unplug the front camera flex and test a call.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
